Implementation pushed: Gerrit change 3193 (patch set 1, 59a56eb1530). Plan review PASS twice (second after adding tests/interfaces/facades/test_mcp_http_transport.py to file_impact; status certified at f13aaa04c2d).

RED on origin/main b5110cb38fa (new tests only, src unmodified): 11 failed. The end-to-end test (box-key-bound close, transport stops, main() cleanup) reproduced the incident text exactly: signed=False, cause=sign_failed, 'the bound op-cert key ... does not exist'. The 3 signing tools left the gauge at 0 while in flight; fsck found no uncertified_close.
GREEN after the fix: tests/unit/test_mcp_drain_signing_iguanodon.py + tests/unit/test_fsck_uncertified_close.py 9 passed; MCP/opcert/fsck/transition-close neighbours 511 passed, 3 skipped; tests/interfaces + docs/mechanism/guide units 2657 passed, 12 skipped; make lint rc 0; make typecheck rc 0 (746 files).

Live store fsck (rebar.fsck_report(report_only=True), live tickets HEAD 3f9577448a8): exactly 3 UNCERTIFIED_CLOSE, all counted=false: 0514-92e0-e6c4-4304 (damageable-huge-xiphosuran), 326f-595a-088b-40a5 (cutprice-untameable-stork), 859c-760d-04dd-44a6 (trifling-countable-armadillo). Not re-signed or modified. The run's 2 counted issues (env_id_mismatch, unsigned_env) come from existing checks unrelated to this change.
